A.name: Constraint
A.target: the graft cannot pay its ordering cost

candidates.note: contains a non-standard residue; cannot be made by recombinant expression, listed but not scored

linker_entropy.model_caveat: The absolute entropies are model values, not measurements. What is not model-dependent: glycine has no CB and therefore the largest backbone state space, so GGGGG is the most expensive 5-mer available. WP45 chose it.

second_constraint.verdict: no second staple is available inside the segments

price.honest_note: Each term is a model. The linker saving uses the same state model that ranked the linkers; the staple gain uses WP45's own 0.6 kcal/mol per torsion. Summing them is legitimate only if they are independent, and they are not fully - a constrained linker reduces the torsions a second staple could remove. The residual is therefore a LOWER bound on the shortfall, and it is reported as such.

miss_attribution.OK-atorvastatin: physicochemical gate (not the layer being fixed)

filter.why_this_is_different: WP47 read alert NAMES and asked whether the name implies reactivity. That inherits every naming error in the catalogue. This reads the SUBSTRUCTURE and tests whether the group is electrophilic. A maleimide is a Michael acceptor whether or not BRENK calls it a phthalimide.

P11.still_unmeasurable: no designs have been synthesised; the rate has no denominator

positive_control.what: a known TPP1 TEL peptide, unmodified, as the competitor
positive_control.why: without it a null result cannot be told apart from a dead assay; with it, a null result is informative
positive_control.measured_basis: E215 sits 3.58 A from K78 NZ in the deposit, so a native TEL peptide must compete; if it does not, the assay is broken, not the design

P12.still_unmeasurable: no docking engine, no MD; WP39 refuted the in-repo rigid-body scorer

assay.primary: MST against the isolated TERT TEN domain
specificity_panel: K78E: designed-around, so affinity must drop
E215K TPP1: the compensatory mutant of K78E
a non-TEN TERT fragment: off-target check

presentation_geometry.meaning: a competitor mimicking the patch must place two carboxylates this far apart, or fail at one of the two contacts - this is the geometry the design is judged on

P12.what_a_design_can_do: reduce risk, not remove it: keep the payload minimal so a null result is interpretable, and include the mutant panel so a hit cannot be an off-site artefact

staple_span_check.skipped_clash: this deposit contains no telomerase chain, so a clash against the partner CANNOT be tested here

fidelity.correction_to_wp47: WP47's clash filter used modelled atoms as the obstacle. Both deposits are coarse: TERT has 8.0 heavy atoms per residue and only 78% of residues have a side chain in 7TRE. Missing atoms cannot clash, so that filter was under-conservative and its clearances are upper bounds.
fidelity.verdict: the staple span survives a conservative re-check
